description: PUT /api/v2/management/webhooks/<id:webhook:contract> with the `write` key (write on the workspace, no organization access). A replacement that keeps the URL, triggers and surveys but changes the source needs `manage`: a third-party source stops the secret from being regenerated and the settings page from editing the webhook.
